predicted_degeneracy.arithmetic: one is a single ochre; by_height paints the five elements on a blue-to-orange ramp sampled at centre height / 4.4, so the third element (hue 0.371, near ochre's 0.104 only in value) and the top two differ most; the base and second element sit close to ochre in value, so the hottest 5% of pixels moves about 18% (a lower bound, one flat light, no shadows). Closest STACK pair: bauhaus vs cut at rule=one, only the sphere/dome vs wedge silhouettes differ, about a quarter of the subject.

chroma_stack.name: Chroma Stack
chroma_stack.description: Static columns from familiar primitives. Original bauhaus/turned/cut stacks contain five pieces at fixed heights. beads/discs/offset/festival contain 6-8 pieces with explicit heights, widths, depth, local XZ offsets and yaw; inspired by the existing primitive-stack-gallery. rule selects one/by_shape/by_height/by_neighbour/composed; composed reads chosen paint per piece, falling back to shape colour. pose adds fixed Y turns and/or XZ taper, clamped to at least 0.25 for longer recipes. Default bauhaus/one/aligned remains unchanged. Conservative box collision follows each piece position, proportions and yaw. Static, no animation or physical balance simulation.

measurements.source: Recipe bounds including rotated slabs and offsets; conservative 2 m square, 4.4 m tall envelope. Runtime probes and renders in doc/space/color-richer-stacks-2026-09-17/.

dev_themes: Build with primitives and static transformations, then add colour
Hold geometry fixed while varying colour assignment
Hold colour assignment fixed while varying rotation and XZ scale
Compose variable proportions, offsets and paint into richer stacks
chroma_stack.qfep_connection: The opening colour hall compares what a fixed construction permits a body to see and walk around. Colour can group its parts differently without changing their geometry or collision; rotated and scaled geometry changes those boundaries independently.
chroma_stack.note: 2026-09-17 richer-stack extension: recipe data extends the existing artifact, not a new generator. Original aligned defaults retained. DNA generated from source exports. Static museum collision/approach and rendered evidence recorded separately; headset not tested.
